listing.name: Wing Commander (Kilrathi Saga) (Wing Commander Reloaded / wc1-re)
listing.summary: Research listing. Upstream route: Native SDL2 Win/Linux/macOS packages and original-data setup. Limits: Native SDL2 port with Kilrathi Saga data and partial DOS compatibility; reference byte similarity does not measure gameplay completion. Upstream platforms: Native Windows/Linux/macOS SDL2 packages; selected CPU architectures unknown in frozen release evidence. Native port differs from incomplete reference reconstruction. Original data: Supply original Wing Commander I: The Kilrathi Saga data, including GAMEDAT and STREAMS/PREFLITE.STR, STREAMS/POSFLITE.STR and STREAMS/MISSION.STR. Original DOS data is only partially supported. No copyrighted game data is included. The native SDL2 port autodetects the selected data directory; contributor WC1.ORI.EXE/code-full requirements are not universal player inputs. Exact accepted Saga/DOS patch fingerprints remain Unknown. Portcove setup/gameplay not verified.
